items.title: Doug Carn interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2023
items.q: We played a little Wilson Pickett, “Midnight Hour,”

ctx.x: Can you name a few tunes that would have been on your songlist?

Well yes, some of them were straight jazz you know. Like we played “Misty,” we played “Red Top,” we played “Blue Moon,” we played “How High the Moon,” we played “The Work Song,” we played a couple of Horace Silver’s that was out in the late 50s. Then we played “Twist and Shout,” the Isley Brothers. We played a little Wilson Pickett, “Midnight Hour,” a little Otis Redding. You know we played what the people wanted to hear.
I understand that group, if I’m correct, auditioned to be on the Ted Mack Amateur Hour? © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-
